candidate_checks.name: Durable staff drafts, independent browser reload, actual A saved preview, retry and conflict recovery
candidate_checks.output_tail:
PASS 1: Clearly test-mode session derives person and organization grants from PostgreSQL; opaque cookie is stored only hashed.
PASS 2: Create retry returns one durable event and identical receipt.
PASS 3: Incomplete event and lot drafts persist atomically; an independent session reads the same DB-confirmed revision.
PASS 4: Ordered lots, idempotent recovery, changed-key rejection, and stale revision conflict preserve later edits.
PASS 5: Actual A saved-draft preview and a new browser context show server-persisted event edits.
PASS 6: Failed save stays unconfirmed, preserves edits and saved preview, then retries to one durable save.
PASS 7: Stale browser save shows a conflict; explicit reload recovers the authoritative revision without overwrite.
PASS 8: Lost response after commit stays unconfirmed, and retry recovers its existing receipt without another revision.
PASS 9: Transaction rejection leaves no partial rows; retry recovers complete lot data/order in SQL, independent API and fresh browser.
9 independent acceptance groups passed.

candidate_checks.name: Session deployment gate, tenant revocation, CSRF, atomic validation, retry and concurrency boundaries
candidate_checks.output_tail:
PASS 1: Anonymous/forged/member-only identity and another tenant cannot read, list, or write staff drafts.
PASS 2: Login and authenticated writes enforce same-origin JSON; rejected CSRF does not change data.
PASS 3: Unknown ownership/history fields, invalid minor units, and duplicate lot identities reject atomically.
PASS 4: Concurrent stale writers yield one durable revision and one conflict.
PASS 5: Composite tenant ownership prevents lot reparenting across organizations.
PASS 6: Revoked staff grant is checked on reads, writes, and idempotent replay.
PASS 7: Person revocation, logout, and expiry invalidate existing server sessions.
PASS 8: Flag-off, production, and custom-domain Preview contexts deny test login and existing staff sessions; forwarded host cannot enable them.
PASS 9: Local auth requires both a loopback origin and explicitly disposable bz_test_* database; valid prior staff cookies cannot bypass either.
9 independent adversarial groups passed.
